decisions.reason: Building on the established offer with a multi-model line keeps the cost of the option low and the resolved uncertainty small, so the option remains worth holding.
A focused supplement with established-offer synergies and a quantified launch remains a low-cost option with little reason to abandon, though its narrower scope adds modest uncertainty.
Although distant from the established offer, its survival for three years suggests the option has not failed and may still hold value, so it is kept while further demand information resolves.
